name: Fresh Atlantic Salmon Fillet (Skinless, Pan-Seared)
whyItWorks: One of the single most therapeutic whole foods for Crohn's disease and Ulcerative Colitis. Rich in marine EPA and DHA omega-3 polyunsaturated fatty acids, which actively resolve intestinal mucosal inflammation. Delicate protein fibers flake easily, requiring minimal digestive exertion.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Sear skinless salmon fillet in 1 tsp olive oil or ghee on a nonstick skillet for 3–4 minutes per side with a pinch of sea salt. Serve over fluffy white rice.
